claims.evidence: No brand/model text, VIN/plate, import documents, or any Belgium-related markings are readable in the shown engine-bay close-up.
The report only shows engine-bay components; there is no video/audio of starting, running, or knocking.
No odometer reading, service records, or evidence of tampering/opening is shown in the close-up.

claims.claim: We offer all our clients 5 star service.
claims.evidence: This is a general service statement with no observable proof in the photos.

risks.risk: Exact motorcycle make/model and engine type are not identifiable from the visible close-up, so compatibility and correct parts/price basis are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bike’s full identification: VIN/chassis number plate and the engine/model label (or a wide shot showing the tank/side panel with readable make/model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used motorcycle engine/bike in unknown condition (worst-case), with no working guarantee.

risks.risk: Working status is unknown: the witness only saw engine-bay parts, not a start/run test; hidden internal damage (knock, low compression, overheating) may exist.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine starting from cold and idling smoothly, plus a brief rev test (audio included) showing no knocking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case), assuming potential mechanical issues.

risks.risk: Missing or swapped components may be present/absent (ECU/ignition sensors/carb/injector parts), which can’t be confirmed from the limited engine-bay view.
risks.proof: A full engine-bay photo set showing all major components (ECU, ignition coil(s), sensors, carb/injector, airbox, wiring connectors) from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown configuration risk (worst-case), requiring parts verification.

risks.risk: Condition problems under covers (oil leaks, cracks, corrosion, worn hoses/wiring) are not visible in the close-up.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside/edges of covers and any accessible areas for leaks/corrosion, plus a wipe-clean check showing no fresh oil seepage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/dirty with possible leaks (worst-case) until leak-free condition is shown.

risks.risk: Mileage/“never opened” claim can’t be validated; internal wear could be higher than stated.
risks.proof: A clear odometer reading photo and a photo showing tamper evidence (e.g., seal marks on fasteners/cover gaskets) if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage (worst-case), not assuming low mileage.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the motorcycle make/model and year (readable from tank/side panel or registration).
Send a clear photo of the VIN/chassis number plate and engine number label (if present).
Send a video of the engine starting from cold and idling (audio included) showing no knock.
Send wide-angle photos of the entire engine bay showing ECU, ignition system, sensors, and whether it’s carb or injector.
Send photos of any service/odometer reading and any tamper/cover seal evidence to support “never opened.”
Send photos checking for oil leaks/corrosion around cover edges and hoses.
response.reason: The witness can only confirm an engine-bay close-up with no readable model/engine identity and no evidence of working condition. Without a start/run clip and identifiable model/engine details, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
